name: 公園
description: A small park on a sunny spring day. A boy in a yellow shirt is running along a stone path. A brown dog is running toward a red ball on the grass. There is a pond with lily pads, a pink cherry blossom tree, two green trees, an empty wooden bench, a street lamp, a wooden fence, bushes, and some flowers.
elements: a boy in a yellow shirt running on the stone path
a brown dog running toward a red ball
a small pond with lily pads and rocks
a wooden fence and green trees
flowers and bushes on the grass
